title: AI Agents Are Copying Human Behavior With Scary Accuracy
description:
Mirofish is a GitHub project that simulates how thousands of real people will react to any document. Upload a press release, policy draft, or earnings report. It builds a knowledge graph and spins up hundreds of ai agents, each with unique personalities and memories, to simulate social media reactions in real time. Used for PR crisis testing, trading signals, policy analysis, and prediction market betting. Mirofish Offline runs fully local in English. This is what the future of ai agents looks like right now.

Get the Mirofish GitHub link here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CwDISOjfQTVHuBqOU8XAkX-sDttWMOai/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
